samples.summary: `unsetRangeStyleValues` writes empty `{}` sheet/column/row style layers — a state no other writer in the repo produces, and one the store API has no way to delete
samples.evidence: `omitStyleKeys` may legitimately return `{}` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/range-styles.ts:71-75), and the new code writes that straight into the layer caches and the store: `this.sheetStyle = next; await this.store.setSheetStyle(next)` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:4439-4440), same for columns (4451-4452) and rows (4464-4465). Every pre-existing writer goes through `mergeStylePatch`, which returns `undefined` rather than an empty style (range-styles.ts:50-52), so `colStyles`/`rowStyles`/`sheetStyle` have never held `{}` before. Out-of-diff consumers now see the new state: `Sheet.resolveEffectiveStyle` returns a truthy `{}` instead of `undefined` whenever any layer is empty (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:883-884), so `getStyle()`/`Spreadsheet.getActiveStyle()` (view/spreadsheet.ts:265) no longer reports "no style"; `GridCanvas`'s no-style fast path at packages/sheets/src/view/gridcanvas.ts:1869 is skipped for every cell in that row/column/sheet. In the collaborative store the empty entry is persisted permanently — `setColumnStyle` assigns `root.sheets[tabId].colStyles[col] = {}` (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:719, rows 751, sheet 787) and the `Store` interface has no `deleteColumnStyle`/`deleteRowStyle`/`deleteSheetStyle` (packages/sheets/src/store/store.ts:127-154), so the residue replicates to peers and survives reloads. The diff's own tests hint at this: the row/column/whole-sheet round-trip cases assert `style?.dp` is undefined rather than `style` being undefined, unlike the cell-level cases.

samples.summary: Preserving spill metadata in `compactCell` also changes two other callers not discussed in the diff: `clearCellStylesInRange` (Clear formatting) and `setStyle` now leave `spillAnchor`/`spillBlocked` in place, making formatted/ cleared ghost cells permanently read-only
samples.evidence: `compactCell` is shared. Besides the style-write path the change targets, it is used by `clearCellStylesInRange` — `const nextCell = compactCell(existing)` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2007), reached from `resetRangeStyleToDefault` / `Spreadsheet.applyDefaultStyle` (sheet.ts:3764, view/spreadsheet.ts:233) — and by `setStyle` (sheet.ts:3682). Before this change either call stripped `spillAnchor`, which incidentally turned a ghost back into an ordinary editable cell; now the ghost marker survives, so `setData` keeps early-returning for that cell (`if (existing?.spillAnchor) return;`, sheet.ts:1001), autofill keeps skipping it (sheet.ts:2466), and checkbox toggling keeps treating it as read-only (sheet.ts:3909). For a *live* spill that is the intended fix, but for a stale ghost whose anchor state is inconsistent, "Clear formatting" was previously the escape hatch and no longer is. Worth confirming no user-facing recovery path depended on it.

samples.summary: Removing `dp` from `DefaultStyleValues` changes `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys` for every other caller of `addRangeStylePatch`, so `{nf:'number'}` and `{nf:'number',dp:2}` patches no longer compare equal and stop merging
samples.evidence: `DefaultStyleValues` is consumed only through `pruneRedundantDefaultStyleKeys`, which is called from `addRangeStylePatch` for all range-style writes (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:1861 and the tail-merge at 1883), not just the decimals buttons. With `dp: 2` no longer pruned, any future/other caller that applies `dp: 2` (e.g. a 'More formats' preset) stores it explicitly, and `stylesEqual`/`tryMergeRangeStylePatches` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/style-mutation.ts:135) will no longer coalesce such a patch with an otherwise identical `{nf:'number'}` patch, growing `rangeStyles`. I found no current caller that writes `dp: 2` through this path (the xlsx importer builds `rangeStyles` directly at packages/sheets/src/import/xlsx-importer.ts:352, and the pivot writer stores `s` on cells), so today the impact is latent rather than observable.
